source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web Overview, check Server information, then select `View more` and check details.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should match the SPEC definition.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES reads guessed `/redfish/v1/Systems/system`, narrows all information to Model/Serial, bypasses both UI views, disables TLS verification and exposes credentials.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires a field/SPEC matrix, linked-resource mapping, UI summary/detail, freshness, role and redaction evidence.

old_problem: The historical record established a complete UI/API/SPEC comparison but retained Pending for the Project field/value matrix, physical-System binding, Redfish/OEM mapping, normalization and sensitive-identifier policy.
disposition_reason: The source's workflow and oracle type are explicit: every Project-defined field in Overview and View more must match the authoritative SPEC. The exact field inventory, values, format rules and Redfish/vendor mappings are Project inputs. The Review layer can require zero unaccounted fields, collection discovery instead of a guessed member, physical-server binding, separate summary/detail evidence and controlled comparison of sensitive identifiers. ED-15 prevents PASS without the signed matrix, ED-20 preserves `all information`, ED-33 retains both UI steps and ED-35 rejects API-only substitution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 853, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
Raw JSON volume and Model/Serial alone cannot prove `all information`; completeness is defined by a signed row-per-field matrix covering both UI views.

The ComputerSystem URI must be discovered from the Systems collection and independently bound to the intended physical server; related properties may reside on Chassis, Manager, Assembly, OEM or vendor resources.
Sensitive serial/asset/UUID values must still be compared in a controlled artifact rather than omitted from coverage.

test_case.test_name: Verify all Overview and View-more Server information against the signed Project SPEC
test_case.purpose: Prove every required Server information field shown in BMC Overview and the `View more` detail represents the intended physical SUT and matches the signed Project SPEC/asset recipe, with each UI field mapped to its authoritative source and supported Redfish/vendor property while preserving sensitive identity data.
required_package: Exact BMC/controller/certificate, firmware/WebUI build and physical server identity
Signed exhaustive field matrix listing Overview/detail location, label, expected value, normalization/case/format rule, authoritative source and sensitivity class
Approved role, locale, viewport, View-more selector/route and loading-complete/permission behavior
Discovered Redfish Systems member URI with stable evidence binding it to the target physical chassis/server
Vendor mapping for ComputerSystem, Chassis, Manager, Assembly, OEM or linked resources plus freshness/ETag/stale and unavailable rules
Trusted TLS, protected browser/API authentication, controlled raw comparison artifact and redacted reporting policy
test_case.test_command: Bind the BMC and physical SUT identities, enumerate `/redfish/v1/Systems`, and select only the ComputerSystem member explicitly correlated to the target; record `@odata.id`, schema type and identity evidence. Capture Overview Server information first, activate the exact `View more` control once and wait for the approved detail-ready state. Collect every field named by the signed matrix from summary and detail DOM/screenshots and the mapped read-only Redfish/vendor resources. Produce a row-per-field comparison of UI summary, UI detail, authoritative API/source and SPEC using only approved normalization rules; account for missing, extra, truncated, stale, redacted, unavailable and permission-filtered values. Retain sensitive exact comparisons in controlled storage and share redacted results. Do not assume `/Systems/system`, clear logs, trigger inventory refresh or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The correct BMC and selected System resource are bound to the intended physical SUT. Every required Overview and View-more field is present in the expected location/role, displays the correct normalized value and agrees with its authoritative Project SPEC/source at acceptable freshness. No required field is silently omitted, sensitive identifiers compare exactly in controlled evidence, and no inventory or log state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified BMC-to-SUT-to-ComputerSystem identity, successful Overview-to-View-more workflow, 100% accounted signed matrix rows, only approved normalization, fresh source evidence and engineer acceptance. A `/Systems/system` dump, Model/Serial match, one UI view, whole-JSON attachment or redaction that prevents controlled equality cannot pass. Any wrong target, missing/extra/unapproved value, mismatch, truncation that hides comparison, stale/mixed data, permission filtering contrary to matrix or unaccounted field is FAIL. Missing signed matrix/mapping is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Enumerate Systems and bind the member to the physical SUT; never assume member ID `system`.
Use trusted TLS and protected credentials; no `-k`, reusable secret in command/process output or unredacted full inventory response.
Do not equate Model/Serial with all information; both Overview summary and View-more detail require exhaustive matrix evidence.
Tokenize/redact serials, asset tags, UUIDs and customer identifiers in general artifacts while preserving exact controlled comparison.
Do not refresh/rescan/synchronize or edit inventory, and never clear dmesg, syslog, SEL, BMC or audit logs.
Perform navigation/read once and stop on wrong-system evidence, identity ambiguity, stale/mixed data, unexpected mutation or inability to protect sensitive values; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Trusted BMC endpoint/certificate, controller firmware/WebUI build, physical SUT identity and selected ComputerSystem `@odata.id`/schema binding
Signed field matrix with expected value, authoritative source, normalization and sensitivity for every required field
Redacted Overview summary and View-more detail screenshots/DOM/routes with role, locale, viewport, ready state and timestamps
Per-field UI-summary/UI-detail/Redfish-or-vendor-source/SPEC table including exact, missing, extra, truncated, stale, redacted and permission-filtered outcomes
Controlled sensitive-identifier equality evidence plus redacted shareable artifacts and resource freshness/ETag metadata
Proof no inventory/log mutation occurred, zero unaccounted fields or explicit NOT READY, limitations and authorized engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong-system binding or sensitive-data exposure, stop, close sessions, quarantine/discard unauthorized unredacted copies and verify the target through the approved OOB inventory path. Do not trigger inventory repair/refresh or repeat collection until the identity/redaction issue is resolved.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require all Server information in Overview and View more to match SPEC; the absent field list is a Project input, not a competing purpose.

blocked.reason: The workflow and comparison objective are clear; exact fields, values, resource mappings and redaction are supplyable execution inputs.
